body.statement: The limit frontiers satisfy \(R(0)=br\) and \(C_\alpha(0)=2br(1-\alpha)\). Conditional on exactly one observed mark, the minimax absolute risk is \(br/(1+cr)\); if \(cr\le1-2\alpha\), the minimax expected interval length is \(b\{2r+(2\alpha/c)\log(1-cr)\}\).
body.justification: Closed-form zero- and one-mark cases independently check the scale, interval realizability, and numerical certification pipeline.
body.gap: Generic bounded-parameter decision theory does not provide these affine weak-mark controls for the COT experiment.
body.consumer: The one-mark length furnishes an independent control for the required \(\lambda=1\) certified linear-program refinement.
